class.name: JRPGChangeItemsCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: gives the party an item or takes it.
class.description: Changes how many of item [member item_id] the party holds by the amount (see [JRPGPartyAmountCommand]), kept within 0 and [constant JRPGGameState.MAX_ITEM_COUNT]. [JRPGChangeWeaponsCommand] and [JRPGChangeArmorsCommand] do the same with weapons and armors; when they take more than the bag holds and [member include_equipped] is on, the rest comes off the party members' equipment, in party order, and is discarded. Authority: server.

members.member: For weapons and armors: a decrease also takes the ones party members have equipped, after the bag.
